question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay in external ClawHub plugins?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the solution changes plugin ranking semantics, persistent FTS index behavior, config/default surface, and fallback policy for existing memory-lancedb users.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid retrieval with explicit config/defaults, FTS index creation, vector fallback behavior, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Defer advanced LanceDB retrieval to ClawHub
options.body: Close or retitle this after maintainers decide BM25/rerank extensions should be owned by external LanceDB memory plugins instead of the official plugin source.

options.title: Keep memory-lancedb vector-only
options.body: Document the official plugin as a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval, avoiding new config and indexing behavior.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid retrieval with explicit config/defaults, FTS index creation, vector fallback behavior, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from prior issue review and memory-lancedb refactor/config history.
